name: Fresh Tomato
description: An ADHD-friendly Pomodoro timer with habits, lined notes, prayer tracker, day planner, About page with release notes and gentle insights. Local-only, no tracking.
author: Fresh Tomato Contributors

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: https://icons.duckduckgo.com https://www.google.com; connect-src 'self' https://icons.duckduckgo.com https://www.google.com; default-src 'self'

toggle-timer.description: Start or pause the focus timer

add-task.description: Open Quick Capture to add a task

start-focus-mode.description: Enter focus mode for the current task
